description: This PHP class 'DatabaseConfigAPI' provides REST API endpoints for configuring database settings during the installation or setup phase of the OrangeHRM system. It handles POST requests to set up database connection parameters and validate the configuration, as well as GET requests to retrieve current database configuration status.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller in PHP that manages database configuration during system installation, allowing retrieval and setting of database parameters.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to set or update database configuration, including validation and error handling based on the supplied parameters.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the current database configuration information.
